hookText: A 27-billion-parameter model that fits in 5.9 gigabytes.

beats.say: Ternary Bonsai 2.5 keeps the previous release's 5.9 gigabyte footprint while improving the capabilities developers need to build agents that work on-device.
Compared with Bonsai 2, it completes tasks in fewer turns, uses fewer tokens, and delivers results faster and more accurately.
On a single NVIDIA H100, it generates 291 tokens per second, and processes a 2,000-token prompt at 3,200 tokens per second.
beats.statLabel: generation speed on a single H100
